title: Prepared nasal LIVE logging with exact-bottle ledger, review protection and safe Undo

changes.title: Record prepared nasal spray administrations
changes.detail: Choose a verified prepared bottle, enter the number of sprays, review the calculated nominal quantity and record a dose with exact prepared-bottle deduction and history in one verified exclusive transaction.

changes.title: Protect bottle calibration and balance across review
changes.detail: A change to the reviewed bottle balance, nominal spray calibration, or transaction count causes the transaction to stop rather than save a different administered amount.

changes.title: Verified prepared-dose Undo and cross-tab rejection
changes.detail: Use the canonical saved state under shared Web Lock and compare-and-swap to save each dose and exact Undo, rejecting stale tabs, mismatched source records and failed writes while preserving the original vial balance.

changes.title: Preserve accepted UI and backed-dose protections
changes.detail: Retain the PR146 search-clear and read-only nasal calculator, plus PR142 backed-dose source reconciliation and failure classification, without altering existing records.

dataImpact: No migration, reset or rewrite of existing localStorage (peptide-tracker-html-v1), protocols, inventory or dose history. A user-confirmed LIVE nasal spray dose appends a new dose and exact prepared-bottle ledger event while decrementing that bottle's verified remaining mass/volume in one exclusive readback-confirmed operation; Undo reverses only that event. The originating physical vial is not deducted a second time. Demo storage stays isolated and fictional. No imports or auto-sync.
limitations: Draft release candidate only: not merged, not deployed, not accepted on physical iPhone for enabled LIVE path.
Theoretical pump calibration and concentration do not establish medical efficacy, safe dosing, physical spray delivery or stability.

Only verified prepared nasal bottles with known spray volume and mass can be used. Invalid sources, changed bottle calibration, stale tabs, insufficient quantities, and failed writes reject rather than saving.
Physical Safari, VoiceOver and Dynamic Type acceptance are required before deployment; independent clinical calculator safety remains unverified.
Generic preparation transfers and unsupported topical administration remain OFF.
